notes: Hilal asks Sa'id («قال سألت سعيد بن جبير»), so Sa'id is a link (rule 5); his answer («قال الشرط بين الناس») is in the same chain
«فحدثته حديثه - يعني عكرمة -»: Ikrima is named only in an editor's gloss between dashes, which is left out, so the speaker of «فحدثني عن ابن عباس» is an unnamed gap between Sa'id and Ibn Abbas
The Companion Ibn Abbas is the last link; the Prophet is not written
